programme.title: Great Destinations Europe
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.desc: Sarah Graham visits the Travers family at the Imire Wildlife Conservancy in Zimbabwe. There she makes a delicious meal of mushroom risotto, green salad with toasted almonds and mini milk tarts.

programme.title: Wine, Dine and Stein
programme.desc: Chef Jack Stein travels with his family to find the ultimate pairings with wine and food.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Throughout the journey, one sacred element has remained constant—Mambe, a traditional preparation of coca leaf that lies at the heart of Indigenous Amazonian life. In this episode, Jeff meets “Happy,” a spirited local who guides him through the complete Mambe-making process, from leaf to ritual. Through the voices of elders and community members, the episode explores the cultural, spiritual, and communal importance of Mambe—revealing its role not just as a sacred tradition, but as a living symbol of identity, respect, and connection to the land.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave and Kari visit the majestic island of Grand Cayman and check out Stingray City.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with some adrenaline pumping sea karting on the West Coast of the Island. He then heads to the home of Manuella to have an Otentik Creole experience with her and her family. A mix of African and European cuisines influenced by Asia, Creole cuisine is a delicious, colorful melting pot of flavours and Manuella teaches Brent just how to blend these notes to create a unique dish. Tasty creole food and too much rum later Brent is having a ball. The next morning Brent hits the markets to get his ingredients for his creole inspired dish. Heading back to the Ravenala hotel he has a refresher before cooking up his own creole creation on the Riviera Riverside.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this unforgettable episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore uncovers the heart of Istanbul—a city where East meets West, and ancient tradition blends seamlessly with modern life. From the vibrant Spice Bazaar filled with Turkish delight and tea, to Michelin-starred Ottoman cuisine that revives centuries-old royal recipes, Sandra dives deep into the flavors and culture of this mesmerizing destination. She explores the mysterious Basilica Cistern, a hidden underground marvel, and reveals the artistry behind handwoven Turkish carpets—each a story told in knots and color. With practical travel tips, immersive storytelling, and a few laughs along the way, this episode is both a guide and a love letter to one of the world’s most captivating cities. Whether you're drawn to history, food, shopping, or simply want to experience something magical, Istanbul delivers—and this episode shows you why it belongs on every traveler’s bucket list.

programme.title: Grand Earth

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.desc: Many cultures believe that human life began in the forest, and for that reason, a deep connection to the plants and animals is always treasured by those who live amongst the trees.

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.desc: The Latin phrase Terra firma means “solid earth”. From ancient history, man has utilized the Terra firma beneath his feet for many reasons but most strikingly to create homes out of the solid earth.

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.desc: Mountains provide a splendid backdrop for communities but they’re also important ecological landscapes. Approximately one-tenth of the world’s population depends on mountains for their life-support.

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.desc: Deserts. Forests. Caves. Mountains. How have human beings adapted to living in the world’s most extraordinary environments? The sheer magnificence of the natural world takes centre stage in this exploration of some of Earth’s most beautiful and most unforgiving environments and the people who have, against the odds, made these places their home.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal tiene cada vez más sospechas sobre Ana y Guillermo, y los invita a un almuerzo para tratar de que ellos durante una charla confiesen involuntariamente que se conocían de antes. Ellos tratan de conversar como si nada pasara, pero es imposible ambos estan enamorados y tratan de evitar que Cristóbal se dé cuenta. La idea del almuerzo fue de Pedro que como espía a todos en el edificio, sabe lo que le pasa a cada persona que vive allí. Venancio sigue sospechando de Pedro y su relación con el hombre muerto que apareció junto al río, pero el estafador aprovechará el interrogatorio para dar vuelta el tablero y sembrar celos de Venancio hacia Lázara, la ex mujer del policía.

programme.title: Episodio 110
programme.desc: Junior y los demás están recibiendo a los invitados. Llega Pastor con Ana. Todos se sorprenden pro Olegario está que ni habla. Dionisia y ROKUro se citan en una heladería. Dionisia piensa que es para decirle la verdad | que no es médico. Pero el lo que hace es darle una tarjeta con su teléfono. Dionisia está feliz y no le importa que no le diga nada. Ya van a casar a Junior y a Jésica cuando llega Briggite y Armando. Se para la boda momentáneamente. Finita va a hablar con Armando.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena es llevada a su casa por Gabriel León. Esto les causa una situación incómoda ya que los dos están casados. Al entrar en su casa, Magdalena encuentra a su hijo Rodrigo llorando en el armario. El papá, Agustín, lo había retado y dejado solo para irse a una reunión con Angie, la esposa de Gabriel. Epicúreo sigue en su papel de homosexual frente a Valentina, para así ganarse su amistad y respeto. Por otro lado, Maikel no está conforme con la mentira, ya que Julieta cree que es verdad que ambos son pareja. Efraín le escribe un poema a Valentina, pero Ana Belén cree que es para ella. Primero se alegra y luego se deprime, al darse cuenta que no habla de ella, sino de otra mujer.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Glorita escapa tras descubrir mentiras de Katiuska. Cecilia llega a Caracas, causando impacto por su parecido con Celia, a quien confronta por culpas pasadas. Marcelo pide el divorcio a Graciela para casarse con María del Pilar. Benjamín retiene a Carrero, pero Katiuska lo libera tras un montaje violento para incriminarlo. Celia, debilitada, pide ser enterrada con su vestido de novia. María del Pilar presiona a Marcelo para casarse tras cambios laborales de este.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo y Leticia sospechan a Isaías como autor de los destrozos del apartamento. René cuenta que Erasto entregó algo a Carmen Rosa en el hospital. Junior se desmaya leyendo el libro de enfermedades mentales. Isaías y Marisela siguen bebiendo. Rosa obliga a Carmen Rosa a confesar su nacimiento pero ella oculta nombres. Adolfo y Consuelo deciden ir al hospital. Mariela, Mildred y José Luis ven a Erasto salir de casa de Natalia. Alejandro anuncia su divorcio. Rosa rechaza a Adolfo y Consuelo como padres con desprecio.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Luis francisco va a la empresa Talamonti para hablar y se encuentra que la presidenta es Clemencia y esta lo odia, al mismo tiempo aparece Augusto que no entiende lo que sucede. Clemencia se queda a solas con Luis Francisco y lo trata con indiferencia. Luis Francisco le confiesa que Augusto es su hermano y Clemencia supone acertadamente que éste está en busca de dinero. Entonces Clemencia le da la dirección de un restaurante y queda en encontrarse con él allí para hablar.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carmen Rosa, presionada por Alejandro y su propia conciencia, confiesa a Rosa que ella la robó a su madre verdadera Consuelo siendo una bebé y huyó a otra ciudad con Arminda. Rosa estalla en llanto sin poder asimilar que la mujer que odió toda la vida es su madre. Junior se debate entre la vida y la muerte. Marisela presiona a Adolfo para hacer abortar a Rosa. Erasto pierde movilidad en las piernas. Eustoquio continúa el plan de enloquecerlo. Rosalía intriga contra Rosa anunciando que jamás la aceptará como hermana en la familia Alamo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa busca a Consuelo en la residencia y se enfrentan como madre e hija, pero el dolor del pasado pesa más que el reencuentro y Rosa marcha sin haber perdonado. Blanca llora abrazada a su nieta. Junior recobra el conocimiento y pide ver a Rosa. Erasto descubre con horror que sus piernas no responden y entra en pánico. Arminda celebra disfrutando del castigo. Adolfo enfrenta a Marisela negándose al aborto. Alejandro y Rosalía viven en tensión permanente. Isaías se ofrece a apoyar a Rosa en su pesadilla familiar. Carmen Rosa, ya sin fuerzas, pide perdón a Rosa por todo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Junior, ignorando que Rosa es su hermana, le jura amor eterno y le pide casarse cuanto antes. Rosa siente la angustia de no poder decirle la verdad. Erasto queda postrado por parálisis total y Arminda lo cuida con satíricos remedios. Eustoquio celebra el castigo divino y proyecta apoderarse de la fortuna. Adolfo decide contarle a Junior la verdad sobre Rosa pero teme su reacción por su delicado estado. Consuelo ruega a Blanca por consejos. Rosa busca refugio en Isaías. Carmen Rosa fallece en su cama dejando a Rosa huérfana de su único amor materno verdadero.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa llora la muerte de Carmen Rosa, la única madre que conoció, sintiéndose huérfana de afecto. Consuelo intenta acercarse al funeral pero Rosa se niega a recibirla. Isaías se mantiene firme apoyando a Rosa. Junior empeora preguntando por Rosa. Adolfo se prepara para confesarle el parentesco. Erasto continúa postrado mientras Arminda y Eustoquio planean su muerte y la apropiación de su fortuna. Vilma es interrogada por la policía sobre el intento de asesinato a Leticia. Rosalía continúa con su odio a Rosa y le exige a Alejandro pruebas formales del parentesco.

programme.desc: Armando totalmente borracho le va a llevar una serenata a Briggite. Ella la recibe maravillada como siempre y cuando se van los mariachis | el se arrodilla y le dice que la ama. Finita se pone a conversar sola ya que Fabián está durmiendo la borrachera y se pone a pensar que le inventa a Armando y lo único que le viene a la cabeza es decirle que tiene una enfermedad terminal. Solymar saca a bailar a Wilker que está totalmente en otro mundo. El acepta pero pensando en Yubiri.

programme.title: Episodio 107
programme.desc: Briggite les cuenta a Ana y a Finita lo de Armando. Finita se desmaya Armando y Atanasio se encuentran y comienzan hablar de Graciela y en este momento de Briggite. Bienvenida va donde Junior y le dice que acepta trabajar en su película. Junior le entrega el guión con unas palabras que hacen llorar a Bienvenida Solymar se porta como novia de Wilker y este no dice nada. Yubiri cree esto y se va para que ellos hablen. Gisela y Juan Diego están de compras y ven a Yubiri.

programme.title: Episodio 108
programme.desc: Armando bota definitivamente a Finita de su oficina y de su vida. Por más que ella quiso explicarle | el no aceptó ninguna explicación y la sacó. Briggite anda perdida como siempre. No sabe lo que está haciendo caminando por un pasillo del centro comercial. Pero se encuentra con Yubiri y aprovecha para decirle que regrese a la agencia. Fabián sigue con el ratón. Llega Palma el Productor para darle una gran noticia a Wilker y es que consiguió una presentación en Sábado Sensacional.

En casa de Briggite están hablando ella Carolina y Dionisia de quienes se están por casar. Llega Junior para informarles que al otro día se casa.

Alejandro cumple su penitencia pidiendo perdón al barrio y confiesa su amor por Margot. Katiuska revela sus planes de casarse con Ricardo por dinero, mientras Juan Marcos intenta detenerla. María del Pilar tiene un encuentro romántico con Gustavo del que se arrepiente, a la vez que recibe un apartamento de Marcelo. Elizabeth rechaza la presencia de Katiuska en la clínica.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia está fuera de peligro y revela su enfermedad a Ricardo, quien se desespera. Katiuska, furiosa tras ser expulsada de la clínica por Ricardo, ordena a Carrero eliminar a Celia. Mientras tanto, René se aleja definitivamente de Marcelo pese a los intentos de Graciela. Manuela perdona a Ricardo pero no olvida, enfocándose en el bienestar de Celia. Margot inicia una relación con Alejandro, y Marcelo se enfrenta violentamente a Gustavo por el amor de María del Pilar.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo se entera de la verdad y Elizabeth le pide no casarse con Katiuska. Alejandro declara su amor a Manuela. Los médicos informan que a Celia le queda poco tiempo de vida; Katiuska envía a Carrero para eliminarla, pero él huye al ser descubierto. Vincenzo y Tirsa revelan la existencia de un testamento actualizado en Italia. Ricardo, harto de las presiones de Katiuska y su familia por la boda, rompe la lista de invitados y abandona la casa para apoyar a Manuela y Celia.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Cuando la salud de Theodore Roosevelt va de mal en peor, el encargado de su rancho debe ir a un poblado Siux para hallar una cura urgente.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Theodore Roosevelt emprende una cacería en las montañas Bighorn de Wyoming, donde se encuentra cara a cara con un oso devorador de hombres.

programme.title: Espionaje en Londres
programme.desc: Durante una ola de asesinatos de agentes indios en Londres, dos agentes especiales se infiltraron en la embajada india en una carrera contrarreloj para identificar a un agente enemigo y evitar una catástrofe.

programme.title: Solo Por Una Noche
programme.desc: El esposo de una mujer casada con una vida perfecta engaña a su hermana, con consecuencias extremas.

programme.title: Espionaje en Londres
programme.desc: Durante una ola de asesinatos de agentes indios en Londres, dos agentes especiales se infiltraron en la embajada india en una carrera contrarreloj para identificar a un agente enemigo y evitar una catástrofe.

programme.title: Kill Kane
programme.desc: Un hombre busca venganza cuando su esposa e hijos son asesinados a manos de una pandilla despiadada. Dado por muerto y sin nadie a quien recurrir, sale a la calle en busca de justicia y toma el asunto en sus propias manos.

programme.title: Diddy: La Caída El Monstruo
programme.desc: El magnate del hip-hop caído en desgracia, Sean "Diddy" Combs, ya no pudo comprar su salida de los problemas cuando un gran jurado lo acusó en septiembre de 2024 de una conspiración de crimen organizado que incluía tráfico sexual, trabajo forzado y soborno. Sin fianza, iba a la cárcel.

2018 es un thriller de supervivencia en malayalam basado en las devastadoras inundaciones de Kerala de 2018. La película entrelaza múltiples vidas: un exmilitar convertido en comerciante, una reportera de televisión, un camionero y funcionarios del gobierno, cuyos caminos se cruzan en medio de la calamidad. A medida que suben las aguas, la gente común se convierte en héroe, arriesgando sus vidas para salvar a vecinos, desconocidos y comunidades.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror: Ataque Al Templo
programme.desc: Inspirada en hechos reales, la película narra la história heroica de los comandos NSG, que intervienen para salvar a personas inocentes cuando los terroristas atacan un templo en Gujarat.

programme.title: Linea del Condado: Todo o Nada
programme.desc: El asesinato de un dudoso abogado en la línea condal, obliga a dos sheriffs a dejar sus diferencias de lado para atrapar al asesino.

programme.title: Boogie: El Aceitoso
programme.desc: Boogie es un asesino a sueldo violento, despiadado y de sangre fría que sigue sus propias reglas. Las mujeres lo aman, los criminales le temen y su habilidad para matar le precede. Explotando con ironía, alcohol y balas ininterrumpidas, esta es una película animada en 3D asombrosa y llena de acción.

programme.title: USS Seaviper: Mision al Abismo
programme.desc: El submarino alemán U-234, del puerto de Kiel, comercia con los japoneses. El USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio. El capitán del USS Seaviper debe desembarcar para realizar un reconocimiento en una isla cerca de Sumatra, pero el barco queda en manos de Mister Cutter, después de que el oficial ejecutivo resulta herido en batalla. Un conflicto entre Cutter y el jefe del barco pone al submarino en peligro. Seaviper está atrapado debajo de la superficie, con menos oxígeno, y un destructor japonés los caza desde arriba. Los daños sufridos por el barco también ponen en duda su supervivencia. Deben luchar contra el destructor japonés y llevar la información sobre el U-235 a Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: En una obra de demolición, el vagabundo Jan Steinert observa a un hombre que esconde una bolsa de deporte verde mientras huye de la policía. Cuando el hombre desaparece, Steinert encuentra el botín del atraco a un banco: ¡53.000 euros! Sin que nadie se dé cuenta, Steinert coge el dinero y deja la bolsa.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Finn investiga por su cuenta tras ser suspendido por herir a un menor armado, hijo de un dueño de burdel.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Harry Siebert, instalador de paneles de yeso, es encontrado muerto a golpes en una obra. Su mujer, Klara, da la primera pista a los detectives: su marido quería reunirse con el jefe de obra, Jens Weigand, para reclamar su salario de los meses anteriores. Como Weigand quería aplazar de nuevo el pago, Harry se enfrentaba a la ruina económica.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Silke Bruhn, de 16 años, aparece muerta en el río Trave. Las primeras investigaciones revelan que fue golpeada antes de morir. Finn y Lars descubren rastros de un picnic en la orilla del río. ¿Se peleó la chica con un chico durante una cita? La madre de Silke y su hermano mayor, Niko, están completamente sorprendidos: Silke quería pasar la noche con su nueva novia.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Nadia Mönning, esposa de un reputado cardiocirujano de Lübeck, sorprende a un ladrón en su casa. Se enfrenta al hombre con una pistola y está a punto de llamar a la policía cuando el ladrón se revela. Se trata del fisioterapeuta de Nadia, Kai Thieme. En ese momento, el suegro de Nadia, Horst Mönning, enfermo terminal, llega para ayudarla.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Franziska aparece muerta en el coche de su marido en coma; sus hijastros podrían dejar el crimen impune.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Vanessa Kühn, una colegiala de 16 años, escapa por los pelos de un intento de secuestro. Una joven que intentó ayudarla resulta gravemente herida en la cabeza. Los detectives temen que el autor vuelva a intentarlo. Ordenan protección policial para Vanessa, que dirige un exitoso canal de belleza como influencer.

programme.desc: Definitely our wildest episode so far. Here’s the deal: Mt. Elgon is an 14,000 foot volcano in eastern Kenya. We propose a safari/ascent of the dormant volcano. Here’s the first kicker: High on the the flanks of the volcano is Kitum Cave – a cave created by the most unique form of erosion – Elephant Erosion. For millennia elephants have been going into the cave to carve it out with their tusks in order to eat the salty rock. Here’s the second kicker: the cave is thought to be the home of the Ebola Marberg virus – the world’s most deadly virus. So here’s the plan: We are going enter the cave, at night, wearing full Bio-Hazard suits to protect us from the virus.

Evans to track massive lightning storms which can produce bolts of up to one hundred million volts. The pair come close - too close - to dangerous electrical clouds swirling over Tucson, Sedona and Monument Valley.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: With summer wildfires overpowering the Yukon forests, host/adventurer George Kourounis follows the fabled route of the Klondike Gold Rush sourdoughs through the bawdy town of Skagway, Alaska, paddling the white water rivers and the White Horse Rapids into the Yukon. He travels on mountain bike, steam train and Cessna to experience the huge fires and meet the northern fire crews battling the blazes.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George tracks twisters through the Tornado Alley and descends into the Erte Ale Volcano.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George investigates the wild side of water in dangerous class 5 river rapids.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world’s worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George experiences the most extreme climates in North America. First he visits the hottest place on the continent – Death Valley, then the coldest – Snag, Yukon.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: In the porous limestone of Canada’s West Coast, great forces are at work under the ground, building and eroding the underground into fantastic shapes. In this episode we’ll witness George’s explorations of these massive underground cave systems.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Stormchasing developed in Australia in the same period – the 1990s – as it developed in the American Midwest. In the first week of December – the height of storm season in Australia, we plan to travel with Jimmy Deguara, the most experienced of Australian stormchasers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. Eastern flanks of the volcano to slip by up to two metres, and many houses on the flanks of the volcano experienced structural damage. The eruption also completely destroyed the Rifugio Sapienza, on the southern flank of the volcano. The Rifugio was the site of a cable car station which had previously been destroyed in the 1983 eruption; both have now been rebuilt. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet

Extreme heat, dehydration, possible sand storms, frigid night temperatures and desert predators are our potential companions for the trip.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Tim arreglan sus cuentas a golpes. Rawlings le propone que se convierta en el mayor lavador de dinero del mundo, y también le pide que elimine al Güero, su obstáculo en la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se reúne en Panamá con Esperanza, su nueva socia, cuya belleza y audacia lo atrapan. El Güero negocia con Tim: le dice que le irá mejor que con Rivero y le pregunta quién es su protegido.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio cae en los brazos de Esperanza y su amiga. Rivero ordena investigar los negocios de Rutila, mientras ella roba información de su computadora, a pedido del Chema. Omar alerta a Mónica.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio les dice a sus socios que ahora se dedica al lavado de dinero y Víctor queda en su lugar. Por orden de Rivero, allanan el local de Rutila y Mónica, y hallan químicos para fabricar éxtasis.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor se enfrenta a Carreño y mata a uno de sus hombres: jura que eliminará al general venezolano la próxima vez que le diga traidor a su tío. Feyo le confiesa a la Condesa que asesinó a Juan.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tijeras ataca con una bazuca a Eleazar y al general Jaramillo, y escapa cuando el ejército llega a su finca. Feyo mata a Justino y hace creer que fueron los Emes. Belén lo defiende ante Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica necesita que Aurelio le consiga la droga para sus socios, pero él le pone como condición que mate al Güero. Andrews le comunica a Tim que queda frente a la DEA y está bajo sus órdenes.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Belén quiere escapar con Aurelio: sabe que Feyo mató a Justino y teme ser la próxima víctima. Los Emes atacan a Feyo, pero él cree que fue Aurelio. Víctor sigue a Mónica hasta la casa de Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Silvestre intenta abusar de Leonor en casa de Elisa, pero Aurelio la salva de nuevo. Ballesteros no dice quién la rescató de las manos del violador. Víctor conoce el plan de Mónica y la sigue.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Conversamos con El Coreanito Mateos, ex-boxeador y ahora entrenador, quien comparte su inspiradora trayectoria desde una infancia difícil hasta convertirse en uno de los referentes del boxeo mexicano. Desde su primer encuentro con un gimnasio a los 13 años hasta ganar el prestigioso torneo Guantes de Oro en 1994, Mateos nos relata cómo la disciplina, la pasión y el sacrificio definieron su carrera. El Coreanito nos lleva al corazón del ring: sus mejores peleas, los retos de mantenerse en forma, las derrotas y victorias que marcaron su vida.

programme.desc: Platicamos con Omar Villarreal, mejor conocido como "Villa Villa", reportero y comentarista deportivo cuya pasión por el futbol lo llevó de jugar en su infancia a convertirse en una de las caras jóvenes de TV Azteca Deportes. Fanático declarado de las Chivas, comparte cómo nació su afición, la emoción de ver a su equipo campeón y la adrenalina de reportear desde la cancha. Con humor, anécdotas y mucha pasión por el futbol, Villa Villa demuestra que el periodismo deportivo es un sueño alcanzable cuando se combina disciplina, entrega y amor por el juego.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Max Barrera, patinador profesional con más de 20 años de trayectoria, sobre lo que realmente implica dedicarse al skateboarding. Max nos comparte cómo se entrena el cuerpo y la mente para dominar trucos, superar el miedo y mantenerse constante en una disciplina que exige creatividad, paciencia y mucha resistencia. Hablamos del proceso detrás de las acrobacias, de cómo se construyen nuevos trucos y de lo que significa patinar desde la calle, con autenticidad, en un mundo donde el skate ya no es solo contracultura, sino también deporte, arte y forma de vida.

Él es el único que conoce el lugar donde está enterrado, pero es asesinado. Ahora, un teniente de la Unión y los dos hijos de McDonald compiten para descubrir dónde se encuentra el oro escondido.

programme.title: El grito en la sangre

programme.title: Rebeldes en Canadá (Hudson River Massacre)

Su líder, Víctor, secuestra a Ann, hija del despiadado terrateniente Sullivan, con la intención de negociar. Sin embargo, ambos terminan enamorándose y unen fuerzas para enfrentarse a la tiranía y luchar por su libertad.

programme.title: Lo quiero muerto
programme.desc: La hermana de Clayton es violada y asesinada. ¡Es hora de una venganza letal!

programme.title: Un hombre vino a matar

programme.title: Imperio del crimen

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Lavrov intenta advertir a Katya del peligro, pero ella no le cree. Rita, por su parte, duda de la culpabilidad de Nikushin. Mientras Lavrov investiga el pasado de Nikushin, Rita sigue una pista sobre la posible implicación de medicamentos en los asesinatos en serie. Katya le confiesa a Nikushin que en el pasado ya intentaron asesinarla. Esa misma noche, otra mujer es asesinada.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Lavrov descubre que estaba equivocado sobre Starostin. Nikushin esconde a Katya en un apartamento secreto y entre ellos surge una atracción. Lavrov empieza a sentirse vigilado, instala una cámara oculta en su oficina y, al revisar las grabaciones, reconoce a alguien entrando. Esa noche, aparece inesperadamente en la casa de Rita, causando un gran susto a su madre.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Nikushin consigue permiso para que Rita y Lavrov visiten a Kosarev en prisión. Durante una fiesta en honor al dueño de la clínica psiquiátrica, Lavrov confronta al desconocido que irrumpió en su oficina. Más tarde, él y Rita dejan la ciudad para entrevistarse con Kosarev. Mientras tanto, un desconocido irrumpe en el apartamento donde se esconde Katya.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: A través del análisis psicológico, Lavrov descubre que Kosarev conoce al verdadero asesino, pero se niega a revelar su identidad. Nikushin encuentra a Katya en un hotel. Un compañero de celda de Kosarev le entrega a Rita y Lavrov una carta que Kosarev intentó destruir. Aunque el remitente usa una dirección falsa, la información hace que Lavrov sospeche de Nikushin.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Lavrov intenta advertir a Katya del peligro, pero ella no le cree. Rita, por su parte, duda de la culpabilidad de Nikushin. Mientras Lavrov investiga el pasado de Nikushin, Rita sigue una pista sobre la posible implicación de medicamentos en los asesinatos en serie. Katya le confiesa a Nikushin que en el pasado ya intentaron asesinarla. Esa misma noche, otra mujer es asesinada.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Lavrov descubre que estaba equivocado sobre Starostin. Nikushin esconde a Katya en un apartamento secreto y entre ellos surge una atracción. Lavrov empieza a sentirse vigilado, instala una cámara oculta en su oficina y, al revisar las grabaciones, reconoce a alguien entrando. Esa noche, aparece inesperadamente en la casa de Rita, causando un gran susto a su madre.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Nikushin consigue permiso para que Rita y Lavrov visiten a Kosarev en prisión. Durante una fiesta en honor al dueño de la clínica psiquiátrica, Lavrov confronta al desconocido que irrumpió en su oficina. Más tarde, él y Rita dejan la ciudad para entrevistarse con Kosarev. Mientras tanto, un desconocido irrumpe en el apartamento donde se esconde Katya.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Nikushin aparta a Rita de la investigación. Kosarev está a punto de ser liberado. Lavrov se infiltra en el apartamento de Nikushin, donde Katya se esconde, y descubre una habitación secreta llena de fotografías y esquemas. Mientras tanto, Rita encuentra la pista del verdadero asesino, quien ya ha sido liberado.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: La investigación llega a un callejón sin salida. Lavrov sufre por la separación de Katya. Nikushin, con su comportamiento impredecible, complica aún más la investigación, haciendo perder un tiempo valioso. Lavrov está decidido a sacarle la verdad a Kosarev. En una operación organizada por Rita y Tolik, las fuerzas especiales intervienen. Katya intenta entender sus sentimientos hacia Nikushin. Rita visita a Lavrov en su apartamento

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Lavrov decide encontrar al asesino por su cuenta. Está convencido de que el asesino, al igual que Kosarev en el pasado, solo es un ejecutor, mientras que el verdadero autor intelectual sigue oculto. Con la ayuda de Nikushin, Lavrov interroga nuevamente a Kosarev.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie seeks shelter from an approaching thunderstorm in a cave under a tree. But when he hears a strange noise from the inside, Rookie tries to retreat quietly but runs straight into Mama Fox, who growls at him to protect her baby inside the cave. Rookie moves aside and decides to leave despite the rain, when suddenly lightning strikes, setting the tree on fire. Immediately, Rookie uses his robo-arms as a water hose to extinguish it and save the little fox family.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: The Who: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970; the group's UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

programme.title: Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Filmed live from the Vic Theatre, Chicago, Illinois, USA in April 2003 for the 'Soundstage' TV series.

programme.desc: The Clash were one of the most influential bands to blow up from the Punk rock scene of 1977, with the late Joe Strummer revered as one of the greatest frontmen in rock'n'Roll music history.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the Circus Krone in Munich, this concert features performances of "Rock N Roll Damnation" and "What's Next to the Moon" and more.

programme.title: Guns N' Roses - Live From The O2 Arena London
programme.desc: Watch this production of Guns N' Roses performing live at the O2 Arena featuring hits: Paradise City, Sweet Child O' Mine, November Rain and many more.

programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: Depeche Mode - Rock Am Ring

programme.title: Imagine Dragons - Live At The Moody Theater
programme.desc: Filmed at The Moody Theater, Texas, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Imagine Dragons featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Demons', 'Radioactive' and many more.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Matchbox Twenty - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans an experience from start to finish; Matchbox Twenty performs their hits including Bright Lights, Parade, You're So Real, and more.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out 3-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in February 2008 when Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969.

programme.title: Elton John: Live in London 2013
programme.desc: Filmed at the Roundhouse in London, this concert film gives fans a live experience from start to finish; Elton John performs his hits: "Tiny Dancer," "Rocket Man," "Your Song," and many more.

programme.title: Diana Krall - Live In Rio
programme.desc: Diana Krall has had a long-time fascination with bossa nova, a type of music which perfectly suits her sophisticated yet sensual style. This stunning concert is filmed in the home of the bossa nova, Rio de Janeiro, in November 2008.

programme.title: Rod Stewart - Live at Hyde Park
programme.desc: Experience the legendary Rod Stewart as he closes Radio 2's Annual Festival In A Day with a memorable performance in September 2015 at London's Hyde Park.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers - Live At Wolf Trap
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, Live At Wolf Trap captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks.

programme.title: Heart - Live At The Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: This film captures not only Heart's first-ever live performance at the Royal Albert Hall but is also the first concert film of Heart performing with a full orchestra.

programme.title: Soundgarden - Live in London 2014
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Qello Concerts' Best
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: Muse: Live at Festival Rock Am Ring

programme.title: Annie Lennox - An Evening of Nostalgia
programme.desc: An Evening Of Nostalgia with Annie Lennox captures one of music's most popular and acclaimed artists in her only full concert performance of songs from her Grammy-nominated Nostalgia album.

programme.title: James Taylor - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas; the festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Maroon 5 -- Live in London 2014

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Jon Foreman, frontman of the GRAMMY-winning rock band Switchfoot, joins Joel Madden for a thoughtful conversation on surfing, faith, creativity, and the balance between joy and discomfort. They explore themes of mindfulness, artistic purpose, and growth through challenge — diving into Jon’s new solo album In Bloom and the philosophies that guide both his music and his life.

programme.title: Tomorrow: Frost Children
programme.desc: Frost Children star in Episode 2 of TOMORROW!, exploring their creative process in New York City and culminating in a live performance.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Hanson: Underneath Experience Tour – Night 1 (Acoustic)
programme.desc: Hanson opens their two-night Underneath Experience Tour with an intimate acoustic performance at The Belasco in Los Angeles, celebrating the 20th anniversary of their landmark 2004 album Underneath. The set blends reimagined hits and deep cuts including “Strong Enough to Break,” “Stories,” and “When You’re Gone,” along with early fan favorites like “A Song to Sing.” Between harmonies and heartfelt stories, the brothers reflect on the album’s creation, early tours, and their enduring connection with fans.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Los Angeles rapper Lefty Gunplay joins Joel Madden for an honest conversation about manifestation, growth, and self-belief. Lefty reflects on overcoming incarceration, finding purpose through music, and representing L.A.’s Mexican community with authenticity and pride. A grounded and motivational dialogue about humility, mindset, and the discipline it takes to turn struggle into success.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Warren Zeiders to discuss his unexpected rise from aspiring lacrosse player to country star. Warren reflects on viral success, hit songs like “Pretty Little Poison,” the pressure of following a breakout year, separating self-worth from streaming numbers, and why his new album No Brakes is his most honest work yet.

programme.title: Pitbull: Live at Rock In Rio
programme.desc: Pitbull performs at Rock in Rio, delivering global hits like Give Me Everything and International Love on a massive stage.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Michael Clifford, guitarist and songwriter of 5 Seconds of Summer, joins Joel Madden to talk about fatherhood, the meaning of maturity, and rediscovering the joy of music through his solo debut Side Quest. Clifford reflects on how parenthood reshaped his creativity, working with bandmate Calum Hood, and learning to write from a more grounded, human perspective.

programme.title: A Night out with the Backstreet Boys
programme.desc: Backstreet Boys perform an intimate 1998 concert in Cologne for 200 fans, featuring early hits with a live string section and choir.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy-nominated drummer Aric Improta joins Joel Madden to talk about the sacredness of creativity, the balance between chaos and discipline, and the art of manifestation. They reflect on Improta’s upbringing in a family of artists, his work with Fever 333 and Night Verses, and the philosophy behind sustaining inspiration while navigating the demands of modern music.

programme.title: Bowling For Soup: Live and Very Attractive
programme.desc: Bowling for Soup performs live on a U.K. tour, delivering hits like 1985 and Girl All The Bad Guys Want with high-energy pop-punk style.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with Dan + Shay. Dan + Shay met at a house party in Nashville in December 2012 and started writing songs together not long after — an unlikely pairing, given Dan came from an emo band background and Shay had been a solo artist on T-Pain's label. Since then, the duo has become one of the most decorated acts in country music history: three consecutive Grammy Awards for Best Country Duo/Group Performance for "Tequila," "Speechless," and "10,000 Hours" with Justin Bieber, alongside dozens of ACM, CMA, and Billboard Music Award wins. Their crossover success has made them global streaming juggernauts, and in 2024 they became the first-ever coaching duo in the history of NBC's The Voice. Sitting down with Joel, Dan + Shay open up about the highs of over a decade together — the awards, the arenas, the recognition — but also the harder work underneath it: learning to communicate honestly, untangling their self-worth from their results, and figuring out what it actually means to build a lasting partnership, both as a band and as best friends.

programme.title: Artist Friendly

programme.title: Cypress Hill: Insane in the Brain

programme.title: Senses Fail: Let It Enfold You

programme.title: Berner / AJ Rafael: Side Hustles

programme.title: a-ha: The Movie
programme.desc: A candid portrait of pop trio a-ha as they revisit the meteoric rise sparked by “Take On Me” and confront creative rifts forged along the way. From teenage dreams to studio breakthroughs, and the pressures of global fame, the film explores whether Morten Harket, Magne Furuholmen, and Paul Waaktaar-Savoy can repair fractured friendships to step back on stage and forge new music.

From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage. Short Description Nonstop live rock performances from concerts around the world.

programme.title: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses: Live From Los Angeles
programme.desc: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses perform a co-headlining concert live from The Wiltern in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Don't Go Gentle: A Film About IDLES
programme.desc: Don’t Go Gentle chronicles the rise of British punk band IDLES, exploring how a group of friends from Bristol transformed pain and vulnerability into creative power. Through candid interviews, raw live performances, and emotional moments, the film captures the band’s journey from small clubs to international acclaim.

programme.title: Jutes: Live From Los Angeles
programme.desc: Jutes celebrates his new album with a live show from Los Angeles’ El Rey Theatre, bringing fans into the room for an intimate performance.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sam Carter, the powerhouse vocalist of Architects, for a candid conversation about gut instincts, creative integrity, and nearly two decades of building one of heavy music’s most influential bands. Sam opens up about his serendipitous bond with Good Charlotte, the “say yes or say no” mindset that guides his decisions, and how gratitude—and a little British self-deprecation—keep him grounded. He reflects on Warped Tour dreams turned stadium reality, the band’s tight-knit dynamic, and why this era is about smiling more, having fun, and bringing the wide-eyed 13-year-old version of himself back on stage. They also talk about Architects’ new album, The Sky, The Earth & All Between (out Feb 28), aiming to make their 11th record their biggest and most honest yet.

programme.title: Hey Violet: The Final Show (Live from Los Angeles)
programme.desc: Recorded live in Los Angeles, this farewell concert captures Hey Violet’s final performance together after nine years as a band. Featuring raw emotion, high energy, and fan-favorite songs, the show is a powerful celebration of their evolution from pop-punk newcomers to alternative mainstays.

programme.title: Motörhead - Live: Everything Louder Than Everything Else
programme.desc: Motörhead performs a high-volume live set in Munich, delivering classics like Ace of Spades and Killed By Death.

programme.title: Maestro
programme.desc: Maestro follows Grammy award-winning conductor Paavo Järvi and brilliant musicians performing in sold-out halls worldwide.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden interviews Twin Tribes (Luis Navarro, Joel Neno Jr.). They discuss DIY origins, the Darker Skies tour, and dark wave/post-punk fandom across Latin America.

programme.title: Believer
programme.desc: Dan Reynolds of Imagine Dragons investigates Mormon church's treatment of LGBTQ members. Rising suicide rates in Utah drive his concern.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Bobby from the British punk-rap duo Bob Vylan joins Joel Madden for an unfiltered conversation about self-determination, identity, and breaking barriers in music. Bobby opens up about growing up between London and Ipswich, navigating racism, finding purpose through education, and how his lived experiences fuel the band’s powerful, socially charged sound.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden interviews Pat Monahan of Train about their success, scoring Begin Again, and the band's upcoming tour.

programme.title: Rascal Flatts: Life Is a Highway Tour: Live from Columbus
programme.desc: Country superstars Rascal Flatts celebrate 25 years of music with a hometown performance in Columbus, Ohio, recorded on their Life Is a Highway Tour. The set features timeless hits like Bless the Broken Road, What Hurts the Most, Mayberry, Fast Cars and Freedom, and Life Is a Highway. It’s an evening filled with nostalgia, gratitude, and classic country harmony.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy starts to worry her whims might have consequences and brings in a scientist and a theologist to unpack chaos theory, the butterfly effect, and free will—while she processes the futility of it all. A game-show parody (“Lucky Case Game”) goes off the rails, the house band Rodent’s Revenge keeps the chaos moving, and Poppy “liberates” her beloved plants with the gift of free will. TV-14. Fictional violence and language.

programme.title: Gottmik / Mayer Hawthorne: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Gottmik launches a beauty brand, while Mayer Hawthorne shares his wine and vinyl-inspired business journey.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Actor and writer O’Shea Jackson Jr. joins Joel Madden for an insightful conversation about Hollywood’s misconceptions, family legacy, and creative purpose. Jackson discusses balancing fame with authenticity, lessons from his upbringing, the importance of privacy in the digital age, and how writing became a core outlet for his creativity.

programme.title: MisterWives: The Don’t Look Down Tour: Live from The Wiltern
programme.desc: Indie-pop band MisterWives close out The Don’t Look Down Tour with an electrifying, sold-out performance at The Wiltern in Los Angeles. Fronted by Mandy Lee, the group performs a dynamic mix of hits and new songs from their album Nosebleeds, blending soaring vocals, raw emotion, and vibrant stage energy. The night captures the band’s message of resilience, growth, and celebration as they connect with fans in a transformative live experience.

programme.title: Get Thrashed Around The World
programme.desc: Stellar metal bands came out of Germany, UK, France, Brazil, Canada, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Canada, and more as part of the Thrash Metal movement. Members of bands like Slayer, Metallica, Slipknot, and Exodus reminisce about their favorite bands and the best musicians of the era. A virtual encyclopedia of metal bands that toured the world, but that fans may have forgotten or can now discover.

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Stiv: No Compromise No Regrets
programme.desc: Almost 30 years after Stiv's mysterious death in Paris, the Dead Boys have become the stuff of (Punk) legends but unsurprisingly, the story remains largely untold. How did this native from Girard, Ohio end up living the life of Riley in Paris, France' Was Stiv really hit by a car (or a taxi...) on that fateful day' Who was the real Stiv Bators' These are a few of the questions answered in STIV.

programme.title: Folk Metal Forest Feast
programme.desc: Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Thrash Metal Attack
programme.desc: Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

programme.title: The Home of Heavy
programme.desc: Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: Together We Rise
programme.desc: A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts Part 2
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Mozart Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt performs with Casco Phil, under the baton of Benjamin Haemhouts.
